origin.summary: User requested replacement of property-backed MCP WebSocket auth with first-admin bootstrap registration, JSON-backed auth storage, one-time returned MCP credentials, and a store-registry interface that can later swap to SQL.

disposition.reason: Discontinued after removing the framework usage; auth will be reimagined as a separate module with SQL/JSON storage options outside meshingress-server.
